title: Mission step enhancement
description: The additions a step enhancement contributes (missions/<type>/enhancements/<id>.step-enhancement.yaml). Its target is not a field: the enhancing pack's graph documents carry the only enhances edge, to action:<type>/<step> (ADR-0053 decision 22; ADR-0064). prompt_fragments names one Markdown companion per slot of that step's prompt (ADR-0066). A semantic check beside this schema requires the id to equal the file stem, each slot to occur at most once, and each named companion to exist beside the enhancement; violations are prompt_fragment_invalid. The guard and emit additions of ADR-0053 decision 22 are not in this shape yet (#428).

schema_version.description: The step-enhancement shape's version, the string "1.0".
schema_version.title: Schema Version

id.description: The enhancement's stable identity; equal to its file stem.
id.title: Id

prompt_fragments.description: Markdown companions to insert into named slots of the enhanced step's prompt. Absent when the enhancement contributes none; never empty. Each slot id occurs at most once. No target, range, anchor, position or priority field exists (ADR-0066 decisions 3, 5 and 7).

slot.description: The slot declared by the prompt in force for the enhanced step: <namespace>:<name>, each part lower-case and starting with a letter.
slot.title: Slot

path.description: The <id>.prompt-fragment.md companion beside this enhancement file; no subdirectory or other file form.
path.title: Path
